sentences.text: 3.The land of village Somasar, Taluka Muli, District Surendranagar, was acquired by the respondents for the Sabury Irrigation Scheme.

The preliminary notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, 'the Act') was published on 08.10.1999 and the notification under Section 6 of the Act was published on 19.12.2000.
The respondent no.1 - Land Acquisition Officer declared award under section 11 of the Act on 21.04.2005 of Rs.1.60/- per square meter towards the compensation.

NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined 4.Being aggrieved by the award, the claimants preferred Land Reference Case No.48 of 2003 under section 18 of the Act before the learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Surendranagar.

5.Learned Judge by impugned judgment and award dated 30.12.2021 partly allowed the references and held that the original claimants are entitled to get amount of Rs. 50.40/- per sq. Mtr. for the acquired land as additional compensation over and above compensation already awarded by the Special Land Acquisition Officer and also entitled to get an increase at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of publication of notification under section 4 of the Act i.e. 08.10.1999 to the date of award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer i.e. 23.07.2001.

Further it was also directed that the claimants are entitled to receive rental/damages at the rate of 15% from NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined the date of taking possession i.e.
10.08.1996 to the date of notification published under section 4 i.e. 08.10.1999 per month per sq.
Mtr. on the market price fixed of Rs. 52/-.

It was further directed that the claimants are entitled to get amount of solatium at the rate of 30% and running interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of award till one year and thereafter at the rate of 15% per annum till the realization of the amount payable under section 28 of the Act.
6.Being aggrieved by the impugned judgment and award, the State Government has preferred the present appeal.

7.Learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr. Kurven Desai has confined his arguments to the interest awarded by the Reference Court and submitted that the Reference Court ought to NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined have considered that in the present case, the possession of the acquired land has been taken by private agreement before the declaration of notice of section 4.

It was submitted that the Court ordered rent to be paid at 15% for the period from the date of possession on 10.08.1996 to 08.10.1999 but as per the Government Resolution dated 18.06.1986 when possession of the land is acquired by private agreement before the commencement of acquisition proceedings, payment of compensation at the rate of 9% of the original compensation amount for the period from the date of possession to the date of payment of compensation i.e. the date of announcement of award under section 11 of the Act,
the rent remains to be paid.

It was submitted that the Reference Court ordered to pay rent at the rate of 15% instead of the rent to be paid at NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER Deputy Collector vs Vashrambhai Prabhubhai Poa Maganbhai ... on 14 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43367826/
2

DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined the rate of 9% of the original compensation and thus interest has to be calculated from the date of announcement of the award and therefore, the order dated 30.12.2021 is erroneous and should be quashed and set aside.
8.On the other hand, learned advocate Mr. Nitin Amin for the original claimants submitted that the said issue has been decided by the cognate Bench in First Appeal No.2700 of 2018 and allied matters challenging the judgment and award dated 09.01.2018 in Land Reference Case No.16 of 2003 and allied matters passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge, Surendranagar pertaining to the same village Dharmendragadh, Taluka Muli, District Surendranagar.

9. It was therefore submitted that considering the decision of the Cognate Bench, wherein the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined issue raised by the State Government has already been dealt with, this Appeal may be dismissed.

10.Having heard the learned advocates for the respective parties, it appears that the Cognate Bench in First Appeal No.2700 of 2018 and allied matters which pertains to same village as that of the present Appeal has decided the issue about rate of interest by observing as under:
"27.
Admittedly, the possession of the acquired lands was taken over on 10th August 1996, i.e. prior to Section 4 notification was published on 24th August 1999.

The claimants/appellants are thus entitled to receive rental/damages at the rate of 15%
from 10th August 1996, i.e. the date of possession, to 24th August 1999, i.e. the date of Section 4 notification, in view of the judgment of this Court passed in the First Appeal Nos.1213 of 2016 to 1241 of 2016.

entities.text: First Appeal Nos.1213 of 2016 to 1241 of 2016
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The appellants/claimants thereafter shall NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2624/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/07/2023 undefined be entitled to 9% interest for the first year from the date of Section 4 notification published under the Act and then at the rate of 15% per year till the amount is deposited with the reference court."

11. In view of above findings arrived at by the coordinate Bench, this Appeal along with Civil Application stands dismissed after hearing the matter at admission stage as the reference court has also passed similar order of awarding rental/damages at the rate of 15% from the date of taking possession till the dated of section 4 notification, whereas interest is awarded as per section 28 of the Act.
Hence, no interference is warranted in the impugned Judgment and Awards.
12. Appeals are accordingly dismissed, No order as to cost.
Civil Application also stands disposed of.
